title: Quarterwatt: a reproducible data lake for European and Turkish electricity markets
description: Quarterwatt is a Python module that builds and maintains a harmonised, quality-checked data lake of electricity-market data for 34 European bidding zones and Türkiye from 2015 onwards: day-ahead, intraday-auction, imbalance and balancing-energy prices (converted to EUR), load, generation by technology, forecasts, cross-border flows, reserve markets, weather and reference data, in 15-minute and hourly resolution. The repository contains code only; users download the data with their own API keys.
